notes.title: Help BEAST succeed, now 40% off!
notes.content:
Dear Beasts,

This is Piotr Pacynko, founder of False Prophet Studio.
I personally wanted to thank you for showing interest in our game.
We've worked very hard to get to this point in our Early Access.

We would like to finalize the game by fixing bugs and polishing it to 1.0 as well as release it for consoles. For us Early Access is just that, a kickstarter where you have to prove yourself. We think that with such a great community, nice media coverage and steam reviews, we're off to a good start.

But marketing, PR and current sales alone is unfortunately not enough so we now turn to you dear community to help us spread the message of being able to buy "BEAST: False Prophet" for an incredible price during Steam sales. We have so many great ideas and plans for this game including additional DLC expansions beyond the 30-40 hours of missions currently available.

Any kind of support will be so greatly appreciated and every single one of you reading this matters for the cause:

 Leaving a review on Steam
 Gifting the game to a friend, family member or loved one
 Telling your family, friends and loved ones about the sale
 Telling your favorite streamers about BEAST and ask them to stream it

If you're still keeping BEAST on the wishlist, now is the time to buy it for an incredible value and help us in the process to be able to complete our first game.

Thank you again for your consideration and support in making our dream a reality and Happy Holidays.

~ Piotr & Team BEAST

notes.title: Major Update #2
notes.content:
Greetings Travellers

We hope this update will find you well, surrounded by joy & warmth, and ready for a new year.

Allow us to present our final update for this year and final game name, BEAST: False Prophet.

[previewyoutube=kCSJncwPaS0;full][/previewyoutube]

In the spirit of giving, we are excited to introduce you to our Major Update #2! Besides all new missions, enemies, and enhanced visuals, you can now finally play the game from start to finish and see our first ending! 

We've left no stone unturned in our quest to make BEAST an unforgettable adventure. We now hope current and future players will see the kind of game we want to finish developing.

As we stand on the edge of finalizing our game, we recognize that our journey has one more chapter of polishing and bugfixing to be done. 

We now turn to our amazing community for help in spreading the word and ask your friends to support future development by buying this early-access version.

Your continued support is the key to making BEAST the masterpiece it deserves to be. Together, let's bring this chapter to a close and set the stage for even more thrilling adventures ahead.

At the end thank you for your amazing support and wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 🎄


➼ join our amazing community on Discord and connect with other players and the BEAST Dev Team!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/65f9bd1068b2f712600fd91f816ff14b459a6370.gif

notes.title: Early Access - Major Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

[previewyoutube=9YzBJdmHDg4;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been hard at work readying up things for today.
This is our biggest update so far and it brings a wealth of changes to improve your time in BEAST and give you lots of new content and variety now with more supported languages! It has been very important to us that we take our time with aspects that may alter the core gameplay. We have added new missions, enemies, weapons, companions, camps, and so much more.

We've also worked on a ton of fixes and improvements largely based on your fantastic feedback received on Discord and forums. If you haven't played in a while, please pick it up again and try things and let us know what you think. As always with indie titles, we're eternally grateful for your support in caring and sharing BEAST to your friends. If you haven't given us a review yet, we would love for you to do so as we read all of them! Lastly if you believe in our work, feel free to nominate us for the Steam Awards and help spread the word about the game. It would mean so much!

 👉 Don't forget to Join & Talk to us on  Discord  

Thank you again dear community!

~ False Prophet Team


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/146eaadbfdd7998d91b68eb0a20c4bc45609efba.png
New Features

 Added UI and subtitle support (beta) for French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
 Added 17 new missions on 13 new maps
 Added 10 new enemy types and 5 new enemy classes
 Added 19 new weapons
 Added 9 new companions
 Added 11 new cutscenes
 Added 17 new camps
 Added NVIDIA DLSS support 
 Added Nudity mode toggle to settings

Community Patch #1,2,3 and 4 are included in this major update as well as additional fixes:

 Added difficulty options when starting a new campaign
-  3 difficulty options: Easy, Normal, Hard
 Added an Ironman mode option when starting a new campaign
- In Ironman mode you only have one autosave slot
 Added a Hardcore mode option when starting a new campaign
- In Hardcore mode, allied characters don't go into a downed state when their Health reaches 0 but die instantly
 Added Overwatch ability for Igor the Coachman

Cutscenes

UX/UI

 Removed the confirmation step for reloading weapons

 Added information on current character level to character examination screen

 Added tooltip status text for downed/retreat/death characters
 General UX/UI improvements
 Updated armor names from “+1/+2” to “Reinforced/Masterwork”
 Added new companion responses to completing or failing their side objectives



Animation

 Improved blending animations between getting hit and being defeated
 Improved timing of gameplay animations, especially the "supporting" ones, like reloading or getting into cover, and other abilities
 Minor animation updates and fixes
 Improved characters rotations in place - turning between 90 - 180 degrees rotation are faster (characters doing one step instead of two)
 Multiple animation updates

notes.title: Community Patch #2
notes.content:
Greetings travelers! 

BEAST Community Patch #2 is officialy live now! We'd like to express our gratitude to the BEAST community for your continued support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable in making this game even better.

We're excited to announce the upcoming release of our Community Patch #2, packed with a host of improvements, bug fixes, and new content based on your valuable feedback. This patch is a collaborative effort between the development team and the dedicated BEAST community, and we're thrilled to share the details with you.

Community-Requested Features: We've listened to your suggestions and we are implementing several features requested by the community! Do you have any idea how we could upgrade your gaming experience? Feel free to post your thoughts on Steam Forum or join our amazing community on Discord and connect with other players and BEAST Dev Team!

Skip tutorial: We understand that most of players will catch up quite fast what button does what and even if, after you played the tutorial once - who would want to play the tutorial maps each time you make a play-through, am I right?

Now you don't have if you don't want to! Ready to dive into the deep waters from the start? We got you covered!

Here is a little GIF with explanation on how to skip the tutorial and start the game from the creation of your main character! Simply in the difficulty settings mark that you want to skip tutorial and press play!

Do you like challenges? Try to play the BEAST without the tutorial and try to discover how mechanics work without any help! We will throw you into the not so shallow waters from the start! Just create your main character and you will be ready to unleash your inner beast without any delays! On the other hand if you would like to have more chill game? TURN OFF PERMADEATH MODE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/f46685e2cec89780f80c8cb5374a17d6b4d82b91.gif

Bug Fixes: Addressed numerous issues reported by the community, including crashes, graphical glitches, and AI behavior problems

Cool feature intro: Igor has learned how to properly make an over watch! Surprise your enemy by being prepared for the attack! Igor can now defend a lot better with this feature added. Now you have an additional tactic in your arsenal!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/d7e4cc49aad5b17ab00f98f239d5681240590917.gif

Cutscenes

Animation

 Fixed an issue with an empty loot chest that can be interacted with for the purpose of the mission's side objective

Thank you for being part of the BEAST universe, and we can't wait to see you on the battlefield!

May the stars align in your favor,

BEAST Dev Team

notes.title: Community Patch #1
notes.content:
Greetings travelers!

We are just past the opening of the Early Access and we would like to thank you for being the most amazing community!
We have received a lot of constructive feedback along with congratulations and words of encouragement. Thanks to your amazing activity we have already managed to squash some nasty bugs that have been reported by you!

In this first community patch, we managed to squash some bugs and improve things in cutscenes, SFX/Audio, and UX/UI along with other fixes and implementation of new features. See the full list of updates here:
[code]
New Features

Added difficulty options when starting a new campaign
3 difficulty options: Easy, Normal, Hard
Added an Ironman mode option when starting a new campaign
In Ironman mode you only have one autosave slot
Added a Hardcore mode option when starting a new campaign
In Hardcore mode allied characters don't go into downed state when their Health reaches 0 but die instantly
Added Overwatch ability for Igor the Coachman

Cutscenes

 Updated visuals for most cutscenes
 Updated audio for cutscenes
 Updated subtitles for cutscenes
 Updated subtitles for level intros

SFX/Audio

 Audio volume rebalance
 Added voiceovers to Commanders’ abilities to increase the clarity of their actions

UX/UI

 Added confirmation popups to Restart Mission and Exit to Menu

 Changed the character level icon background to yellow, for it to be more easily distinguished from Action Points icon

Fixes

 Replaced the generic Unreal Engine application icon with our custom BEAST one
 Fixed an issue with Health bars not showing for all characters targeted by area of effect abilities
 Fixed an issue with the player not being able to close Options or Load Game menus while in Pause Menu
 Fixed a potential issue with Overwatch being triggered by characters behind the attacker (outside of the visible cone)
 Fixed a potential issue with VFX not being displayed when applying various bonuses to characters via abilities

When starting a new campaign you can now select between 3 difficulty options: Easy, Normal, Hard and even Ironman mode.

notes.title: BEAST Early Access is opening on October 25th 2023!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/395f6700cf09c11bfa0d3549bf6ce065bd13e10a.png

Early Access and Content Creator program announced!
We're very happy to announce that you will be able to play BEAST through Early Access from October 25th! If you're not only a curious player but also a content creator, we're happy to tell you that we will be opening our Content Creator Program from that same day as well but you can already get in touch by signing up here!

[previewyoutube=GlgvSLkHXNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Why Early Access?

We want to make sure we create the best possible game for fans of turn-based tactical RPGs.
Early Access allows us to be close to our current and future players who will be able to join our journey of completing our first game. Having our foundation solid and validated by our BEAST community before we launch the full game is our highest priority.

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

We are very excited to go on this journey where there will be frequent updates to the game, community surveys and insights into our development and how your feedback is vital in all of it. We consider our Steam forums and official Discord channel our prime channels to talk with us.

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

The EA version is currently in Alpha (early) state and contains a chunk of the game with over 20 playable missions, 2 main characters, 7 enemy classes, 11 enemy types and 40 weapon types. Many hours of replayable fun awaits! More languages are coming later this year as well.

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

We’re committed to 2024 so it’s months rather than years.

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

As this is truly an Alpha version of the game (which means actual early code) there is a lot of stuff planned to be implemented, fixed, updated, balanced and optimized before full release. You will hear temporary music, voice overs and sound effects. You will see strange animations & graphics and you’ll likely be able to exploit combat systems at times. The full game will include side missions, additional story missions, more customization, enemies and much more. If you’re looking to be able to get in early and help finish a dark tactical game you’d want to play, this is it!

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

Yes, the “Loyal Edition” which we will talk more about shortly will only be available during Early Access and will include the game, digital artbook, wallpapers, unique weapon, equipment skins and soundtrack (content will be able to be downloaded as they become available) for a special price as a thank you to our early adopters (subject to change).
